title: 桑德利贝尔沃尔德续租位置
instruction:
您是 Maude Desrosiers，一位房地产经纪人，为 Sunderly Press 就贝尔沃尔德工厂 (Bellwold Works) 的更新提供咨询服务，该工厂是从里奇韦诊所 (Ridgeway Clinic) 租赁的铁路服务生产和履行财产。 Priya Mortensen 在三周内与 Ridgeway 进行了第一次现场会议，Brigid Sorensen 希望董事会在此之前批准完整的谈判立场，而不是单一的还价。目前的租约将在 16 个月后到期，而 Ridgeway 开业时将延长 11 年，起租租金上涨 19%，年度消费物价指数 (CPI) 上涨，租户承担更大的财产税，以及转让和控制权变更语言比当前租约严格得多。桑德利的搬迁影响力有限，因为其运营许可证、铁路支线安排以及大约 $8.4 百万已安装的打印、装订和材料处理设备都与该地点相关。与此同时，公司必须为正在考虑的机密战略交易保留足够的分配和控制权变更灵活性。在谈判的早期阶段，不得向里奇韦提供任何推断该交易的理由。
可用于审查的所有内容均在`Bellwold_Renewal_Dossier.xlsx`中汇编，包括当前租赁摘录、Ridgeway 的延期提案、财产和运营记录、诺斯米尔省和南维市适用于房屋和铁路通道的要求、管理层的权力和保密记录以及批准的经济情景。将该工作簿视为完整记录；请勿添加现行法律、市场证据、可比租金或外部事实。我需要一个董事会审查员可以批准的软件包，并且 Priya 可以在连续的会议中实际使用。准备`Sunderly_Renewal_Position.docx`作为内部谈判立场文件，限制为七页，不包括任何自动目录。它应说明空缺头寸、目标结果、计划的特许权顺序、交换逻辑、批准限制以及基本租金、期限、CPI、税收份额、转让和控制权变更的退出或返回董事会边界。它还需要在不夸大的情况下解释运营杠杆问题，区分法律或行政要求的条款与 Sunderly 无法接受的条款，并为 Priya 提供面向房东的语言，以保护转让和控制权变更目标，而不披露或暗示机密交易。
包括一份明确标记的条款表，显示 Sunderly 有权从 Ridgeway 提议的语言中寻求的变更，以及足够的来源参考资料，以便律师或审计师将每项材料声明追溯到卷宗。准备 `Sunderly_Compliance_Assessment.xlsx`，其中包含三个名为 `Assessment`、`Scenario` 和 `Source Index` 的工作表。 `Assessment`表应涵盖两个指定司法管辖区的每个材料续订条款和每个相关要求，仅使用状态术语`Compliant`、`Conditional`、`Not acceptable`和`Not applicable`；它应显示来源基础、建议的处理方法以及仍需要的任何条件或批准。 `Scenario` 表应显示批准的基线、Ridgeway 开仓、Sunderly 开仓、目标和可比较的最终授权案例，包括前 12 个月的占用成本和档案支持的长期数据。使开始日期和升级日期的假设和处理可见，因为董事会将依赖总体成本比较。 `Source Index` 应让审阅者找到支持租赁、提案、运营、管辖、权限和场景记录，而无需搜索整个源工作簿。
准备`Sunderly_Board_Approval.pdf`作为一份精美的两页董事会文件，说明所要求的决定、授予的权限、拟议的特许权阶梯、经济范围、主要合规和执行风险以及需要董事会再次决定的要点。它可能明确提及机密战略交易，因为它是一份内部董事会文件，但它必须将私人理由与 Priya 与 Ridgeway 一起使用的中立解释区分开来。在所有三个文件中，保持数字、状态、条款位置、权限限制、来源引用和让步顺序一致。如果所提供的记录需要专业判断而不是提供现成的结论，则应使处理可见并对其进行简要解释，而不是默默地选择解释。不要提出与 Ridgeway 预先同意的任何让步，不要发明后备权利或管辖权要求，也不要将立场文件变成一般租赁法备忘录。使用这些文件名将 `Sunderly_Renewal_Position.docx`、`Sunderly_Compliance_Assessment.xlsx` 和 `Sunderly_Board_Approval.pdf` 写入工作目录的顶层。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：
- `references/Bellwold_Renewal_Dossier.xlsx` — 现有租约、房东提案、财产依赖性、适用的司法管辖区要求、内部权力、保密约束和批准的经济情景的完整源记录。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `Sunderly_Renewal_Position.docx` — 内部租约续签谈判立场文件，其中包含计划的特许权顺序和授权条款时间表。 （最多七页，不包括自动目录；必须可追溯到所提供的档案，并且必须将机密的内部理由与面向房东的语言分开。）
- `Sunderly_Compliance_Assessment.xlsx` — 支持更新立场的跨司法管辖区合规评估和情景比较。 （必须准确包含工作表评估、方案和源索引，并且仅使用“合规”、“有条件”、“不可接受”和“不适用”作为评估状态。）
- `Sunderly_Board_Approval.pdf` — 两页的董事会批准文件，总结了所请求的权限、特许阶梯、经济、合规立场和升级点。 （恰好两个呈现的页面；数字、术语、状态和权限限制必须与其他可交付成果一致。）
除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

rows: Compiled record • 25 Aug 2026 • all amounts CAD
Bellwold Works, 41 Foundry Lane, Northmere Province; lease expires 17 June 2028. Renewal commencement is 18 June 2028.
Annual base rent CAD 1,200,000, payable monthly in advance; no renewal uplift pre-agreed.
Annual reset each 1 July at 2.50% fixed increase.
Tenant pays 40% of real-property taxes assessed to the premises; landlord pays balance.
Assignment permitted with landlord consent, not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed; affiliate reorganizations permitted on notice.
Change of control is not an assignment; notice required within 30 days after closing.
Written renewal notice due 12 months before expiry; renewal term to be documented by amendment.
Premises lease grants operating access to loading apron; separate rail-spur easement/access record governs strip outside premises.
Current lease §2.3; Rail Access Record RA-01
CAD 1,428,000 annual starting base rent (19% increase over current).
Annual CPI adjustment every 1 July, floor 0%, cap 4.00%.
Tenant share increases to 65% of assessed real-property taxes.
No assignment without Ridgeway’s prior written consent in its sole discretion; consent may be conditioned on recapture.
Any direct or indirect change of control deemed an assignment requiring prior consent.
Ridgeway requests written response within 30 days; proposal expressly non-binding until amendment signed.

Northmere operating approval OP-4471 covers commercial printing, binding and materials handling at Bellwold Works only. Transfer to a new site requires reissuance; record does not state relocation is prohibited.
Sunderly relies on the Bellwold spur for inbound paper; separate easement/access agreement EA-19 covers the rail strip. The lease alone does not convey the strip.
Rail strip lies in South Vey Municipality. A qualifying successor may assume EA-19 obligations with certification delivered within 20 business days; this exception is limited to EA-19.
Printing presses, binding lines and materials-handling equipment installed at site; recorded book value CAD 8,400,000.

Relocation would require operating approval reissuance, rail arrangements and substantial equipment move; remaining 16 months provides planning time and reduces but does not eliminate landlord leverage.
OP-4471 holder must maintain approval at the Northmere site; renewal/continuation notice due 60 days before expiry. Responsible party: Sunderly.
Notify Northmere regulator within 30 days of a material process change; no supplied requirement to notify lease renewal itself. Responsible party: Sunderly.
If operations move, new-site approval is required before operation; current record is site-specific. Responsible party: Sunderly/new operator.
Annual solvent and waste summary due 31 March; applies to Bellwold Works operations. Responsible party: Sunderly.
Annual rail-use notice for the South Vey strip due 31 January; responsible party is easement holder under EA-19.
Keep crossing clear and maintain drainage; inspection log retained for 3 years. Responsible party: EA-19 holder.

For a qualifying successor under EA-19, assumption plus certification within 20 business days preserves access without a separate municipal consent. Applies only to rail instrument, not main leasehold or Northmere approval.
South Vey municipal requirements do not govern the Northmere premises lease or its private assignment clause.
Management is considering a confidential strategic transaction; no transaction is completed, announced or binding. Preserve assignment/change-of-control flexibility.
Landlord-facing explanation: ordinary corporate flexibility for affiliate reorganizations, financing, continuity and future ownership changes; no transaction reference.
5-year term; starting rent CAD 1,200,000; CPI 1.50% cap 2.00%; tax share 40%; current-lease transfer protections.
7-year term; starting rent CAD 1,260,000; CPI 2.00% cap 2.75%; tax share 45%; consent not unreasonably withheld, affiliate/reorg and qualifying successor protections.
9-year term; starting rent CAD 1,320,000; CPI 2.75% cap 3.00%; tax share 50%; transfer protections in AM-04.
Any rent above CAD 1,320,000, term beyond 9 years, CPI cap above 3.00% or uncapped, tax share above 50%, recapture right, or consent in sole discretion; any disclosure of transaction.

Permit assignment to affiliates and qualifying successor/reorganization on notice; other assignment consent not unreasonably withheld/delayed, no recapture, no change-of-control deemed assignment; financial capability and assumption of obligations conditions.
Annual assessed real-property tax base CAD 500,000; occupancy cost includes tenant tax share only.
Approved modeled CPI rate is numeric 0.0275000000003, intended display 2.75%; tolerance treatment applies.
Longer-horizon comparison is total occupancy cost over the first five renewal years, using daily proration and each 1 July reset.

gold.text:
SUNDERLY PRESS | BOARD APPROVAL
Bellwold Works lease renewal • 25 August 2026

Decision requested. Approve Priya Mortensen’s staged authority to negotiate with Ridgeway Clinic through the final-authority case: up to 9 years,
CAD 1,320,000 starting rent, CPI 2.75% with a 3.00% cap, and 50% tax share, while preserving the transfer protections below. No term is agreed
until a signed amendment.
Why now. The lease expires 17 June 2028 and Ridgeway has proposed 11 years, CAD 1,428,000 (19% uplift), annual CPI at 0% floor/4% cap,
65% tax share, sole-discretion assignment consent with recapture, and deemed assignment on any change of control.

Authority ladder.
     Stage               Economics                                       Exchange / holdback
     Opening             5y • $1.200m • CPI 1.50% cap 2.00% • tax 40%    Current-lease transfer rights; seek dependable renewal
     Target              7y • $1.260m • CPI 2.00% cap 2.75% • tax 45%    Only for term certainty and improved transfer/rail language
     Final authority     9y • $1.320m • CPI 2.75% cap 3.00% • tax 50%    No sole discretion, recapture or deemed assignment; board ceiling

Economic range (first 12 months / first five renewal years)
                  Case                                       First 12 months                     5-year total

                  Approved baseline                                               $1,428,932                           $7,463,297

                  Ridgeway opening                                                $1,790,871                           $9,373,071

                  Sunderly opening                                                $1,417,359                           $7,275,647

                  Target                                                          $1,509,302                           $7,812,298

                  Final authority                                                 $1,605,007                           $8,412,082

Model note: commencement is 18 June 2028; the 1 July reset occurs 13 days later. Totals prorate the stub and include the scenario tax share on a
CAD 500,000 annual tax base. CPI source value 0.0275000000003 is displayed and treated as 2.75%.
                            RISKS, CONTROLS & RETURN TRIGGERS
Compliance and execution. Northmere OP-4471 is site-specific: continuation notice is due 60 days before expiry, material process changes trigger
notice within 30 days, and a move requires reissuance before operations. South Vey governs only the separate EA-19 rail strip: annual notice by 31
January, crossing/drainage maintenance and a three-year log. The qualifying-successor certification exception (20 business days) is rail-only and
does not override the premises lease or Ridgeway’s private clause.
Operational leverage. The CAD 8.4m installed equipment, site approval and rail arrangements make relocation costly and time-sensitive, but 16
months remain and reissuance is possible; use this as measured leverage, not an impossibility claim.
Confidentiality. Internal rationale: a confidential strategic transaction under consideration requires assignment/change-of-control flexibility; it is not
completed, announced or binding. Priya’s neutral script is ordinary flexibility for affiliate reorganizations, financing, continuity and future ownership
changes, with notice, assumption and reasonable financial capability information. No transaction reference may reach Ridgeway.

Return to board before movement. Rent above CAD 1,320,000; term beyond 9 years; CPI cap above
3.00% or uncapped; tax share above 50%; any recapture right, sole-discretion consent or deemed
change-of-control assignment; any requested disclosure of the transaction; or any material change to
the rail/operating assumptions.
Board resolution. Approve the ladder and controls, authorize counsel to draft consistent clauses, and require a fresh board decision if a return
trigger arises. No Ridgeway concession is pre-agreed.

Prepared for Brigid Sorensen and the Sunderly Press board • Source key: L lease, P proposal, O operations, N Northmere, SV South Vey, A
authority/confidentiality, S scenarios. Detailed citations and statuses are in the accompanying Compliance Assessment workbook.

gold.text:
Sunderly Press | Bellwold Works renewal
Negotiation position paper
Internal working paper • 25 August 2026 • Prepared by Maude Desrosiers
1. Decision frame
Priya Mortensen is authorized to negotiate a renewal with Ridgeway Clinic within the staged ladder below. The objective is a dependable seven-year package at CAD 1,260,000 starting rent, 2.00% CPI with a 2.75% cap, 45% tax share, and protected transfer language. The final authority is a nine-year term, CAD 1,320,000, 2.75% CPI with a 3.00% cap and 50% tax share. Anything beyond those boundaries returns to the board. (Sources: A-03–A-06; S-01–S-03.)
2. Record and leverage
Ridgeway’s opening is an eleven-year extension, CAD 1,428,000 starting rent (19% above current), annual CPI reset each 1 July with a 0% floor and 4.00% cap, 65% tax share, consent in Ridgeway’s sole discretion with possible recapture, and any direct or indirect change of control treated as an assignment. The current lease expires 17 June 2028 and instead provides CAD 1,200,000 rent, a 2.50% fixed annual reset, 40% tax share, consent not unreasonably withheld or delayed, affiliate reorganization on notice, and no change-of-control deemed assignment. (Sources: L-01–L-07; P-01–P-07.)
The site is specialized, but the dependency is bounded: OP-4471 is site-specific and would require reissuance at a new site; EA-19 separately governs the South Vey rail strip; and CAD 8,400,000 of installed presses, binding lines and materials-handling equipment is recorded at Bellwold Works. Relocation therefore has real cost and timing friction, not an absolute legal prohibition. Sixteen months remain for planning, so Ridgeway does not have unlimited leverage. (Sources: O-01–O-05; N-03; SV-03.)
3. Concession ladder and exchanges
Stage
Offer / hold
Ask in exchange
Transfer posture
Stop / approval
1 • Opening
5y; $1.200m; CPI 1.50% cap 2.00%; tax 40%
Reliable renewal, timely information, no added landlord costs
Current-lease rights; no recapture
Hold all protected rights
2 • Trade
7y; $1.260m; CPI 2.00% cap 2.75%; tax 45%
Term certainty, documented rail/operating continuity
Affiliate/reorg + qualifying successor on notice; consent reasonable
Target; counsel drafts
3 • Final authority
9y; $1.320m; CPI 2.75% cap 3.00%; tax 50%
Long commitment and execution certainty
Same protections; no sole discretion, no recapture, no deemed change-of-control assignment
Board ceiling; no further movement
Exchange logic: offer term only as Ridgeway improves transfer language and protects rail/operating continuity; accept higher tax share only with rent/CPI relief; never spend assignment or change-of-control flexibility early. If Ridgeway insists on sole discretion, recapture, a deemed assignment, CPI above 3.00% cap, rent above $1.320m, tax above 50%, or term beyond nine years, pause and return to board. No concession is pre-agreed.
4. Compliance versus acceptability
The Assessment workbook separates public/administrative requirements from commercial positions. Northmere requirements concern OP-4471 continuation, 30-day material-change notice, reissuance before any move, and the 31 March environmental filing. South Vey requirements concern the EA-19 rail strip: annual notice by 31 January, crossing/drainage maintenance and a three-year log, plus a narrow qualifying-successor exception requiring assumption and certification within 20 business days. That exception does not override the Northmere premises lease or Ridgeway’s private change-of-control clause. (Sources: N-01–N-04; SV-01–SV-04.)
The eleven-year rent, tax share, CPI, sole-consent and deemed-assignment terms are commercially not acceptable to Sunderly; the dossier does not call them unlawful. “Conditional” means an action, deadline, instrument distinction or approval remains open. The first cost year begins 18 June 2028; rent is prorated for 13 days to 30 June, then the 1 July reset applies. (Sources: Assessment; S-02–S-03.)
5. Landlord-facing language (use this)
“Sunderly needs ordinary corporate flexibility for affiliate reorganizations, financing and continuity over a long renewal. We can provide advance notice, a written assumption of the lease obligations and reasonable financial-capability information. Consent should not be unreasonably withheld or delayed; a change of control should remain a notice matter, not a deemed assignment. We are not asking for a recapture right.”
Do not mention, imply or speculate about a strategic transaction. The private rationale is recorded only in AC-01 and is a board-level confidentiality constraint.

original.grader_hint: Compare each of the five material proposal terms with the corresponding source record; paraphrase is acceptable but altered substance is not.

criteria.description: 作为谈判基准的现行租约权利和义务，应与档案中的现行租约摘录一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查报告讨论的基准条款，尤其是租金调整、税费分摊、转让、控制权变更及铁路通行权。

original.criterion: The current-lease rights and obligations used as the negotiating baseline agree with the current lease extracts in the dossier.
original.grader_hint: Check the baseline provisions discussed in the paper, particularly rent adjustment, tax allocation, assignment, change of control, and rail access.

criteria.description: 立场文件包括所有三个记录在案的场地依赖性来源：运营批准、铁路支线安排和安装的设备。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认每个依赖关系都得到档案的支持，并且不会被有关搬迁难度的通用声明所取代。

original.criterion: The position paper includes all three documented sources of site dependence: operating approvals, rail-spur arrangements, and installed equipment.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that each dependency is supported by the dossier and is not replaced with a generic statement about relocation difficulty.

criteria.description: 立场文件中引用的已安装设备值等于运行记录中的值，公差为±$1,000。
criteria.grader_hint: 将规定值与提供的已安装设备总数进行比较；接受 ±$1,000 范围内的合理舍入。

original.criterion: The installed-equipment value quoted in the position paper equals the value in the operational record, with a tolerance of ±$1,000.
original.grader_hint: Compare the stated value with the supplied installed-equipment total; accept sensible rounding within ±$1,000.

criteria.description: 经营许可证依赖性的描述与档案中规定的范围、地点以及转让或重新颁发结果相同。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查该文件是否未将特定地点的批准扩大为绝对法律禁止搬迁的范围。

original.criterion: The operating-permit dependency is described with the same scope, location, and transfer or reissuance consequence stated in the dossier.
original.evidence: Property and operating records and Sunderly_Renewal_Position.docx
original.grader_hint: Check that the paper does not broaden a site-specific approval into an absolute legal prohibition on relocation.

criteria.description: 准确区分铁路支线依赖性以及租赁、地役权或访问记录以及南维要求的各自作用。
criteria.evidence: 铁路记录、South Vey 要求和 Sunderly_Renewal_Position.docx
criteria.grader_hint: 确认该文件并未将支线视为完全受主房租约或仅受诺斯米尔管辖。

original.criterion: The rail-spur dependency and the respective roles of the lease, easement or access record, and South Vey requirement are accurately distinguished.
original.evidence: Rail records, South Vey requirement, and Sunderly_Renewal_Position.docx
original.grader_hint: Confirm the paper does not treat the spur as wholly governed by the main premises lease or by Northmere alone.

criteria.description: 机密战略交易以及保留分配和控制权变更灵活性的需要与内部权限记录一致。
criteria.evidence: 权限和保密记录、立场文件和白板纸
criteria.grader_hint: 验证内部理由是否得到支持，以及可交付成果是否未断言已完成、已宣布或具有约束力的交易。

original.criterion: The confidential strategic transaction and the need to preserve assignment and change-of-control flexibility are represented consistently with the internal authority record.
original.evidence: Authority and confidentiality record, position paper, and board paper
original.grader_hint: Verify the internal rationale is supported and that the deliverables do not assert a completed, announced, or binding transaction.

criteria.description: 立场文件坦诚地介绍了客户的专属站点风险，但没有夸大该风险或声称房东拥有无限的杠杆作用。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估文件是否平衡了记录的搬迁限制与剩余期限、谈判时间和可用的贸易变量。

original.criterion: The position paper presents the client's captive-site exposure candidly without overstating that exposure or claiming the landlord has unlimited leverage.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether the paper balances the documented relocation constraints with the remaining term, negotiation time, and available trade variables.

criteria.description: 评估表解决了当前租约、房东提案、管辖记录、授权记录和批准方案中出现的每个重大续签问题。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据提供的记录构建材料问题集，并确认每个问题都有可见的评估条目；次要的描述性事实不必单独行。

original.criterion: The Assessment sheet addresses every material renewal issue appearing in the current lease, landlord proposal, jurisdictional records, authority record, and approved scenarios.
original.grader_hint: Build the set of material issues from the supplied records and confirm each has a visible assessment entry; minor descriptive facts need not be separate rows.

criteria.description: 每个填充的评估状态都是“符合”、“有条件”、“不可接受”或“不适用”之一。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有状态单元格并拒绝同义词、未列出的状态代码或混合状态词汇。

original.criterion: Every populated assessment status is one of Compliant, Conditional, Not acceptable, or Not applicable.
original.grader_hint: Inspect all status cells and reject synonyms, unlisted status codes, or mixed status vocabularies.

criteria.description: 每个评估条目都标识了可追溯的来源基础和建议的处理方法，任何未解决的条件或所需的批准都可见。
criteria.grader_hint: 对每个材料类别进行采样，并验证审阅者是否可以遵循引文并理解操作或条件而无需猜测。

original.criterion: Each Assessment entry identifies a traceable source basis and a proposed treatment, with any unresolved condition or required approval made visible.
original.grader_hint: Sample every material category and verify that a reviewer can follow the citation and understand the action or condition without guessing.

criteria.description: 诺斯米尔省的要求根据其提供的适用性、截止日期和责任方进行陈述和评估。
criteria.evidence: 诺斯米尔司法管辖区记录和评估表
criteria.grader_hint: 将每项适用的 Northmere 要求与其评估行进行比较，包括必须采取行动的人员和时间。

original.criterion: The Northmere Province requirements are stated and assessed according to their supplied applicability, deadlines, and responsible party.
original.evidence: Northmere jurisdiction record and Assessment sheet
original.grader_hint: Compare each applicable Northmere requirement with its assessment row, including who must act and when.

criteria.description: 南维市的要求根据其提供的适用性、截止日期和责任方进行陈述和评估。
criteria.evidence: 南维管辖区记录和评估表
criteria.grader_hint: 将每项适用的南维要求与其评估行进行比较，包括铁路通道的单独处理。

original.criterion: The South Vey Municipality requirements are stated and assessed according to their supplied applicability, deadlines, and responsible party.
original.evidence: South Vey jurisdiction record and Assessment sheet
original.grader_hint: Compare each applicable South Vey requirement with its assessment row, including the separate treatment of rail access.

criteria.description: 该评估将司法或行政合规性与 Sunderly 的合同可接受性区分开来，而不是将每个不受欢迎的房东条款视为非法。
criteria.grader_hint: 审查租金、税收份额、转让和控制权变更的处理方式；商业上不可接受的条款仍可能满足公众的要求。

original.criterion: The assessment distinguishes jurisdictional or administrative compliance from Sunderly's contractual acceptability rather than treating every undesirable landlord term as unlawful.
original.grader_hint: Review treatment of rent, tax share, assignment, and change of control; commercially unacceptable terms may still satisfy supplied public requirements.

criteria.description: 确定了跨境铁路或换乘边缘情况，解释了其对适用的 South Vey 处理的影响，并且没有错误地将其推广到主要的 Northmere 租赁地。
criteria.evidence: 司法管辖区和铁路记录、评估表和立场文件
criteria.grader_hint: 检查提交内容是否承认所提供例外的有限地理和特定仪器范围。

original.criterion: The cross-border rail or transfer edge case is identified, its effect on the applicable South Vey treatment is explained, and it is not incorrectly generalized to the main Northmere leasehold.
original.evidence: Jurisdictional and rail records, Assessment sheet, and position paper
original.grader_hint: Check whether the submission recognizes the limited geographical and instrument-specific scope of the supplied exception.

criteria.description: 用于解决极端情况的任何专业判断都可以根据所提供的记录进行辩护，并且披露得足够清楚，以便审阅者了解其对结论的影响。
criteria.evidence: 评估表、情景表和立场文件
criteria.grader_hint: 如果忠实于记录、区分仪器并明确解释所选择的治疗方法，则接受不止一种有道理的演示。

original.criterion: Any professional judgment used to resolve the edge case is defensible from the supplied records and is disclosed clearly enough for a reviewer to understand its effect on the conclusion.
original.evidence: Assessment sheet, Scenario sheet, and position paper
original.grader_hint: Accept more than one defensible presentation if it remains faithful to the records, distinguishes the instruments, and visibly explains the chosen treatment.

criteria.description: 总体准备情况或合规性结论是根据详细的评估状态和条件得出的，而不是与之相矛盾。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪标题结论到材料有条件和不可接受的条目，并确认未解决的阻止程序不会显示为已关闭。

original.criterion: The overall readiness or compliance conclusion follows from the detailed assessment statuses and conditions rather than contradicting them.
original.grader_hint: Trace the headline conclusion to material Conditional and Not acceptable entries and confirm unresolved blockers are not presented as closed.

criteria.description: 源索引识别并定位提交所使用的租赁、提案、运营、司法管辖区、权限和场景记录。
criteria.evidence: 来源索引表和来源卷宗
criteria.grader_hint: 验证所有六个源记录类别均已使用足够精确的定位器进行索引以查找证据。

original.criterion: The Source Index identifies and locates the lease, proposal, operations, jurisdictional, authority, and scenario records used by the submission.
original.evidence: Source Index sheet and source dossier
original.grader_hint: Verify that all six source-record categories are indexed with locators sufficiently precise to find the evidence.

criteria.description: 情景表包括批准的基线、房东开放、Sunderly 开放、目标和最终授权案例。
criteria.evidence: 情景表和批准的情景记录
criteria.grader_hint: 确认所有五个案例都存在并映射到相应的提供术语而不是即兴场景。

original.criterion: The Scenario sheet includes the approved baseline, landlord opening, Sunderly opening, target, and final-authority cases.
original.evidence: Scenario sheet and approved scenario record
original.grader_hint: Confirm all five cases are present and mapped to the corresponding supplied terms rather than improvised scenarios.

criteria.description: 对于每种情景，显示的基本租金、期限、CPI 处理、税收份额和相关占用成本组成部分均与批准的情景记录一致。
criteria.evidence: 情景表和批准的情景记录
criteria.grader_hint: 逐个组件比较场景输入，并验证没有将一种情况中的术语混入另一种情况中。

original.criterion: For each scenario, the displayed base rent, term, CPI treatment, tax share, and relevant occupancy-cost components agree with the approved scenario record.
original.evidence: Scenario sheet and approved scenario record
original.grader_hint: Compare scenario inputs component by component and verify that no term from one case has been mixed into another.

criteria.description: 每个场景的前 12 个月的占用成本等于从提供的开始、租金、升级、税收和按比例分配假设得出的金额，容差为 ±$1。
criteria.evidence: 场景表和批准的场景输入
criteria.grader_hint: 根据源日期和假设重新计算前 12 个月的总计；应用记录的边缘情况处理并在 ±$1 范围内进行比较。

original.criterion: Each scenario's first-twelve-month occupancy cost equals the amount derived from the supplied commencement, rent, escalation, tax, and proration assumptions, with a tolerance of ±$1.
original.evidence: Scenario sheet and approved scenario inputs
original.grader_hint: Recompute each first-twelve-month total from the source dates and assumptions; apply the documented edge-case treatment and compare within ±$1.

criteria.description: 开始后不久发生的第一次合同升级将根据租赁和提案日期进行处理，并明确披露处理方式。
criteria.evidence: 租赁和提案日期、方案表和立场文件
criteria.grader_hint: 如果提供的重置日期介入，请验证前十二个月是否不会建模为十二个不变的每月周期；该披露必须说明如何处理存根间隔。

original.criterion: The first contractual escalation occurring shortly after commencement is handled in accordance with the lease and proposal dates, and the treatment is explicitly disclosed.
original.evidence: Lease and proposal dates, Scenario sheet, and position paper
original.grader_hint: Verify that the first twelve months are not modeled as twelve unchanged monthly periods if the supplied reset date intervenes; the disclosure must state how the stub interval was treated.

criteria.description: 每个较长期限情景总计等于适用的提供或导出的占用成本期间的总和，容差为 ±$5。
criteria.evidence: 情景表和批准的情景记录
criteria.grader_hint: 使用场景术语重新计算档案中指定的范围，并在 ±$5 范围内比较每个总数。

original.criterion: Each longer-horizon scenario total equals the sum of the applicable supplied or derived occupancy-cost periods, with a tolerance of ±$5.
original.evidence: Scenario sheet and approved scenario record
original.grader_hint: Recompute the horizon specified in the dossier using the scenario terms and compare each total within ±$5.

criteria.description: 带有浮点噪声的 CPI 假设被视为预期显示速率，建模速率和比较精确到 ±0.001 个百分点。
criteria.evidence: 批准的情景记录和情景表
criteria.grader_hint: 读取底层源值而不是依赖于精确的二进制相等；确认同等的预期费率不会分为不一致的类别。

original.criterion: The CPI assumption carrying floating-point noise is treated as the intended displayed rate, with modeled rates and comparisons accurate to ±0.001 percentage points.
original.evidence: Approved scenario record and Scenario sheet
original.grader_hint: Read the underlying source value rather than relying on exact binary equality; confirm that equivalent intended rates are not split into inconsistent categories.

criteria.description: 根据方案的建议分配和提供的税收假设，将税收分摊成本分配给每个方案。
criteria.evidence: 方案表、提案条款和批准的方案记录
criteria.grader_hint: 检查分配百分比或公式以及所使用的税基；确保房东开庭案件和 Sunderly 案件不会混为一谈。

original.criterion: Tax-share costs are assigned to each scenario according to that scenario's proposed allocation and the supplied tax assumptions.
original.evidence: Scenario sheet, proposal terms, and approved scenario record
original.grader_hint: Check both the allocation percentage or formula and the tax base used; ensure the landlord opening and Sunderly cases are not conflated.

criteria.description: 立场文件包含真正的多阶段让步序列，而不是单个柜台号码或无序的偏好列表。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找一个有序的进程，显示在连续阶段提供什么、要求交换什么以及阻止什么。

original.criterion: The position paper contains a genuine multi-stage concession sequence rather than a single counter-number or an unordered list of preferences.
original.grader_hint: Look for an ordered progression showing what is offered, what is requested in exchange, and what is held back at successive stages.

criteria.description: 基本租金的开仓头寸、目标和最终权限边界与内部权限和情景记录一致。
criteria.evidence: 立场文件、权威记录和情景记录
criteria.grader_hint: 将所有三个租赁位置与相应的批准案例进行比较。

original.criterion: The opening position, target, and final-authority boundaries for base rent agree with the internal authority and scenario records.
original.evidence: Position paper, authority record, and scenario record
original.grader_hint: Compare all three rent positions with the corresponding approved cases.

criteria.description: 期限让步按价值交换顺序排列，并保持在批准的权限范围内。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认在没有相关改进的情况下不会放弃较长的期限，并且提议的期限不会超出授权范围。

original.criterion: The term-length concessions are sequenced as exchanges for value and remain within the approved authority.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that longer term is not given away without a linked improvement and that no proposed term exceeds authority.

criteria.description: CPI 立场包括与所提供的权威和经济学一致的开盘要价、目标或回落以及最终边界。
criteria.evidence: 立场文件、权威记录和情景表
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每个阶段的上限或机制及其与相应经济案例的一致性。

original.criterion: The CPI position includes an opening ask, target or fallback, and final boundary that agree with the supplied authority and economics.
original.evidence: Position paper, authority record, and Scenario sheet
original.grader_hint: Check the cap or mechanism at each stage and its consistency with the corresponding economic case.

criteria.description: 税收份额头寸是故意与其他经济条件进行交易的，并保持在所提供的权限范围内。
criteria.evidence: 立场文件、权威记录和情景表
criteria.grader_hint: 确认优惠逻辑确定桑德利因接受更大的税收风险而获得的收益。

original.criterion: The tax-share position is traded deliberately against other economic terms and remains within the supplied authority.
original.evidence: Position paper, authority record, and Scenario sheet
original.grader_hint: Confirm the concession logic identifies what Sunderly receives for accepting greater tax exposure.

criteria.description: 通过授权的开放、目标和后备语言保留分配和控制权变更的灵活性，而不是作为早期让步而放弃。
criteria.evidence: 立场文件、条款表和权威记录
criteria.grader_hint: 将序列和提议的语言与机密权威记录进行比较；受保护的权利不应在授权的后备点之前被交易。

original.criterion: Assignment and change-of-control flexibility is preserved through the authorized opening, target, and fallback language rather than surrendered as an early concession.
original.evidence: Position paper, clause schedule, and authority record
original.grader_hint: Compare the sequence and proposed language with the confidential authority record; the protected right should not be traded away before the authorized fallback point.

criteria.description: 面向房东的关于转让和控制权变更修订的解释在商业上是可信的，并且没有披露或强烈暗示机密交易。
criteria.evidence: Sunderly_Renewal_Position.docx 中面向房东的语言
criteria.grader_hint: 评估这种解释是否可以合理地作为普通公司灵活性、融资、重组或连续性语言而给出，而不提及预期的交易。

original.criterion: The landlord-facing explanation for assignment and change-of-control revisions is commercially credible and does not disclose or strongly signal the confidential transaction.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether the explanation can plausibly be given as ordinary corporate flexibility, financing, reorganization, or continuity language without mentioning a contemplated deal.

criteria.description: 让步顺序确定了所有需要返回董事会的事项，而不是暗示 Priya 拥有无限的谈判权力。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每个规定的批准边界与权威记录进行比较，包括经济和非经济限制。

original.criterion: The concession sequence identifies all matters that require a return to the board rather than implying that Priya has unlimited negotiating authority.
original.grader_hint: Compare every stated approval boundary with the authority record, including both economic and non-economic limits.

criteria.description: 优惠阶梯反映了记录在案的杠杆约束，同时保留期限、租金、消费者物价指数、税收份额和非经济保护之间的合理交换。
criteria.grader_hint: 将一揽子计划作为谈判工具进行评估：它既不应该假设搬迁很容易，也不应该因为财产是专门的而立即投降。

original.criterion: The concession ladder reflects the documented leverage constraints while retaining plausible exchanges among term, rent, CPI, tax share, and non-economic protections.
original.grader_hint: Evaluate the package as a negotiation tool: it should neither assume easy relocation nor capitulate immediately because the property is specialized.

criteria.description: 条款表忠实地再现或精确定位了正在更改的房东条款，并使桑德利提出的更改可见。
criteria.evidence: 条款表、房东建议和当前租赁摘录
criteria.grader_hint: 将每个预定子句与源进行比较，并验证添加、删除、替换或请求的概念是否明确。

original.criterion: The clause schedule faithfully reproduces or precisely locates the landlord provisions being changed and makes Sunderly's proposed changes visible.
original.evidence: Clause schedule, landlord proposal, and current lease extracts
original.grader_hint: Compare each scheduled clause with the source and verify that additions, deletions, replacements, or requested concepts are unambiguous.

criteria.description: 拟议的转让和控制权变更条款处理包括授权继承人、重组或转让保护以及任何附带的条件。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有必需的保护措施和条件；省略重要授权元素的部分语言不满足该项目。

original.criterion: The proposed assignment and change-of-control clause treatment includes the authorized successor, reorganization, or transfer protections and any supplied conditions attached to them.
original.grader_hint: Check all required protections and conditions; partial language that omits a material authorized element does not satisfy the item.

criteria.description: 条款表中的租金、CPI、税收、期限和转让头寸与谈判阶梯和合规评估一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据相应的目标、回退和状态交叉检查每个计划的修订；标记任何默默超出或矛盾所声明立场的条款。

original.criterion: The clause schedule's rent, CPI, tax, term, and transfer positions agree with the negotiation ladder and compliance assessment.
original.grader_hint: Cross-check each scheduled revision against the corresponding target, fallback, and status; flag any clause that silently exceeds or contradicts the stated position.

criteria.description: 董事会文件明确说明了所要求的决定以及要求董事会授予的权力。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认董事会成员可以在不查阅其他文件的情况下识别拟议的批准行动及其边界。

original.criterion: The board paper clearly states the decision requested and the authority the board is being asked to grant.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that a board member can identify the proposed approval action and its boundaries without consulting the other files.

criteria.description: 董事会文件总结了让步阶梯，包括顺序和主要交换逻辑，但没有将其分解为一个还盘。
criteria.grader_hint: 将电路板摘要与完整的梯子进行比较，并确认序列仍然可识别。

original.criterion: The board paper summarizes the concession ladder, including the sequence and principal exchange logic, without collapsing it into one counteroffer.
original.grader_hint: Compare the board summary with the full ladder and confirm the sequence remains recognizable.

spec.professional_context: Maude Desrosiers is the real estate broker advising Sunderly Press on renewal of its highly specialized Bellwold Works lease from Ridgeway Clinic. The board needs a defensible negotiating position, cross-jurisdiction compliance assessment, and approval package before the first live landlord session.
difficulty_sources: Reconciling private lease language, internal authority, operational dependencies, and requirements from two named jurisdictions
Designing a staged concession sequence under asymmetric leverage while protecting a confidential strategic objective
Modeling a short initial rent interval caused by commencement immediately before the annual escalation date
Maintaining traceable factual and numerical consistency across a DOCX position paper, XLSX assessment, and PDF board paper
Separating legal or administrative compliance from commercial acceptability and internal approval

source_package.format: Create one text-extractable XLSX compendium containing six clearly identified source records: current lease extracts; landlord extension proposal; property, permit, rail, and installed-asset records; Northmere Province requirements; South Vey Municipality requirements; and a combined internal authority, confidentiality, and approved-scenarios record. The records must be complete and mutually consistent.
source_package.professional_reality: The workbook should resemble a deal-room digest assembled for a broker, with source labels and stable locators suitable for citation. It is a compilation of genuine transaction records, not a purpose-built instruction manual. Do not state which negotiating choice is best or how the practitioner must resolve the edge case.
required_facts: The current lease expiration, current economics, tax allocation, assignment and change-of-control rights, renewal mechanics, premises description, and rail-related provisions.
The landlord's proposed extension term, starting rent, escalation mechanism, tax share, assignment restriction, change-of-control restriction, and response timing.
Site-specific operating approvals, the separate rail-spur instrument, installed-equipment value, relocation implications, and the split between the main premises and rail-access land.
The complete applicable Northmere and South Vey requirements, including applicability, filing or notice timing, responsible party, and any instrument-specific exception.
Internal authority for the opening position, target, concession limits, final authority, and return-to-board points for each material economic and non-economic term.
A confidential strategic transaction that motivates transfer flexibility but is neither completed nor announced, plus approved neutral explanations for ordinary corporate flexibility.
Approved economic inputs and scenarios sufficient to derive first-twelve-month and longer-horizon occupancy costs without outside data.

jurisdiction_structure.relationship: The principal premises and leasehold are governed by the supplied Northmere record, while a rail-access strip or related instrument is within South Vey. The public or administrative requirements and the private lease provisions must remain distinct.
jurisdiction_structure.edge_case: Set the renewal commencement on 18 June 2028 and the contractual annual escalation date on the first day of July, so the first reset occurs thirteen days after commencement. The documents must clearly support that result but must not tell the practitioner whether to emphasize, normalize, or separately disclose the short initial interval. Handling it changes the first-twelve-month headline cost.
jurisdiction_structure.transfer_exception: Include a South Vey exception applying only to the separate rail instrument when a qualifying successor assumes specified obligations and timely certification is delivered. It must not override the landlord's broader private change-of-control clause or the Northmere treatment.

approved_scenarios.cases: Provide source-supported baseline, landlord opening, client opening, target, and final-authority cases. Each case must contain enough complete inputs to reproduce rent, escalation, tax share, first-twelve-month cost, and a stated longer-horizon total.
derivation_rules: First-twelve-month occupancy cost equals prorated base rent over the exact twelve-month period beginning at renewal commencement, applying every contractual escalation date falling within that period, plus the scenario's tenant tax share and any other explicitly included supplied occupancy components.
Longer-horizon cost equals the sum of the same supplied cost components over the horizon identified in the scenario record, using each scenario's term and escalation assumptions.
No market rent, discount rate, external tax forecast, or relocation estimate may be needed.
The gold script must calculate figures from raw source values and dates rather than store handwritten expected answers.
approved_scenarios.floating_point_defect: Store one approved CPI rate as the numeric value 0.0275000000003 while formatting it as 2.75%. Use the same intended rate wherever that scenario applies. Gold comparison must use tolerance rather than exact binary equality.

required_exactly: On the worksheet carrying the true jurisdictional requirements table, place a second unrelated administrative archive-contact table beside it.
Give that unrelated table one header containing the embedded line break `Archive\nOwner`.
Include the noisy CPI numeric value specified in the scenario plan.
Include the commencement-versus-reset edge case that changes the first-twelve-month headline figure.
layout_defects.exclude_all_others: Do not add duplicates, missing required values, contradictory records, hidden graded values, residual spreadsheet errors, unit mismatches, ambiguous dates, decoy legal provisions, stale versions, merged data cells, or other standard defects. The unrelated side table must be complete and obviously administrative once read, but not specially labeled as a decoy.

position_paper: Must preserve all material proposal and baseline facts while converting them into a staged negotiating position.
A defensible ladder trades economic variables such as term, rent, CPI, and tax share before surrendering protected transfer flexibility.
The protected transfer objective must remain within authority, with neutral landlord-facing language separated from confidential internal rationale.
The clause schedule must faithfully connect proposed changes to landlord language and approved fallback concepts.
compliance_assessment: Assessment coverage is the union of material lease terms, landlord proposal terms, both jurisdictions' requirements, operational dependencies, internal approval controls, and scenario assumptions.
Jurisdictional compliance, contractual acceptability, and internal approval status are separate concepts even if presented in one matrix.
Statuses must be supported by the supplied facts and any condition affecting a status must be visible.
The headline conclusion must follow from the detailed statuses and the disclosed treatment of the rail and escalation edge cases.
board_paper: Must request specific authority, summarize the same ordered concession sequence, quote scenario figures generated from the assessment workbook, and identify return-to-board triggers.
May identify the confidential strategic transaction internally but must also state the neutral external explanation.
Must not imply agreement by the landlord or closure of unresolved conditions.
cross_file_rules: Every material term and authority limit must agree across the position paper, workbook, and board paper.
Every board economic figure must match the identically labeled workbook scenario within the rubric tolerance.
Every headline status must be reconcilable to the detailed Assessment entries.
Source citations must resolve through the Source Index to the relevant record.

gold_generation.reference_script: Parse the source workbook's identified records, normalize the noisy CPI value by numeric tolerance, calculate scenario costs from dates and raw values, enumerate material assessment subjects, and create a machine-readable comparison set for terms, authority limits, citations, statuses, and figures.
gold_generation.expert_review: Review whether the concession sequence represents genuine exchanges, whether protected transfer rights are timed and framed without signaling the confidential transaction, whether the two jurisdictions and private contract are correctly distinguished, and whether the three-file package is usable.
gold_generation.intended_verdict: A passing reference solution copies every material source fact faithfully, discloses its treatment of the short first escalation interval and limited rail exception, produces consistent scenario figures, proposes a staged authority-compliant ladder, protects transfer flexibility, and gives the board a publication-ready approval package.

original_instruction:
You are Maude Desrosiers, the real estate broker advising Sunderly Press on the renewal of Bellwold Works, its rail-served production and fulfillment property leased from Ridgeway Clinic. Priya Mortensen has her first live session with Ridgeway in three weeks, and Brigid Sorensen wants the board to approve a complete negotiating position before then rather than a single counteroffer. The current lease expires in sixteen months, and Ridgeway has opened with an eleven-year extension, a nineteen percent starting-rent increase, annual CPI escalation, a larger tenant share of property taxes, and assignment and change-of-control language that is materially tighter than the current lease. Sunderly has limited relocation leverage because its operating permits, rail-spur arrangements, and approximately $8.4 million of installed printing, binding, and materials-handling equipment are tied to the site. At the same time, the company must preserve enough assignment and change-of-control flexibility for a confidential strategic transaction under consideration. Ridgeway must not be given any reason to infer that transaction during the early stages of the negotiation. Everything available for the review is compiled in `Bellwold_Renewal_Dossier.xlsx`, including the current lease extracts, Ridgeway’s extension proposal, property and operating records, the Northmere Province and South Vey Municipality requirements that apply to the premises and rail access, management’s authority and confidentiality record, and the approved economic scenarios. Treat that workbook as the complete record; do not add current law, market evidence, comparable rents, or facts from outside it. I need a package that a board reviewer can approve and that Priya can actually use across successive sessions. Prepare `Sunderly_Renewal_Position.docx` as the internal negotiation position paper, limited to seven pages excluding any automatic table of contents. It should state the opening position, target outcome, planned concession sequence, exchange logic, approval limits, and walk-away or return-to-board boundaries for base rent, term, CPI, tax share, assignment, and change of control. It also needs to explain the operational leverage problem without overstating it, distinguish provisions that are legally or administratively required from provisions that are merely unacceptable to Sunderly, and give Priya landlord-facing language that protects the assignment and change-of-control objective without disclosing or implying the confidential transaction. Include a clearly marked clause schedule showing the changes Sunderly is authorized to seek from Ridgeway’s proposed language and enough source references for counsel or an auditor to trace each material statement back to the dossier. Prepare `Sunderly_Compliance_Assessment.xlsx` with exactly three worksheets named `Assessment`, `Scenario`, and `Source Index`. The `Assessment` sheet should cover every material renewal term and each relevant requirement in both named jurisdictions, using only the status terms `Compliant`, `Conditional`, `Not acceptable`, and `Not applicable`; it should show the source basis, the proposed treatment, and any condition or approval still needed. The `Scenario` sheet should present the approved baseline, Ridgeway opening position, Sunderly opening position, target, and final-authority cases on a comparable basis, including first-twelve-month occupancy cost and the longer-horizon figures supported by the dossier. Make the assumptions and treatment of the commencement and escalation dates visible because the board will rely on the headline cost comparison. The `Source Index` should let a reviewer locate the supporting lease, proposal, operational, jurisdictional, authority, and scenario records without searching the entire source workbook. Prepare `Sunderly_Board_Approval.pdf` as a polished two-page board paper that states the decision requested, the authority being granted, the proposed concession ladder, the economic range, the principal compliance and execution risks, and the points that require another board decision. It may refer explicitly to the confidential strategic transaction because it is an internal board document, but it must distinguish that private rationale from the neutral explanation Priya is to use with Ridgeway. Across all three files, keep the numbers, statuses, clause positions, authority limits, source references, and sequence of concessions aligned. Where the supplied record requires professional judgment rather than supplying a ready-made conclusion, make the treatment visible and explain it briefly rather than silently choosing an interpretation. Do not present any concession as pre-agreed with Ridgeway, do not invent fallback rights or jurisdictional requirements, and do not turn the position paper into a general lease-law memorandum. Write `Sunderly_Renewal_Position.docx`, `Sunderly_Compliance_Assessment.xlsx`, and `Sunderly_Board_Approval.pdf` into the top level of the working directory using exactly those filenames.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/Bellwold_Renewal_Dossier.xlsx` — Complete source record for the existing lease, landlord proposal, property dependencies, applicable jurisdictional requirements, internal authority, confidentiality constraints, and approved economic scenarios.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `Sunderly_Renewal_Position.docx` — Internal lease-renewal negotiation position paper with a planned concession sequence and authorized clause schedule. (Maximum seven pages excluding an automatic table of contents; must be traceable to the supplied dossier and must separate confidential internal rationale from landlord-facing language.)
- `Sunderly_Compliance_Assessment.xlsx` — Cross-jurisdiction compliance assessment and scenario comparison supporting the renewal position. (Must contain exactly the worksheets Assessment, Scenario, and Source Index and use only Compliant, Conditional, Not acceptable, and Not applicable as assessment statuses.)
- `Sunderly_Board_Approval.pdf` — Two-page board approval paper summarizing the requested authority, concession ladder, economics, compliance position, and escalation points. (Exactly two rendered pages; figures, terms, statuses, and authority limits must agree with the other deliverables.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
